what_it_is: Agent-operated development evidence on the same development build and the same kept home after setup: what the App shows on the next launch, signed out, read by views and by opening disclosures and one account check. The labels of the disclosures and of the account check are read from the App's source at the revision built, not from a recorded view. It is not a person's observation and meets no criterion.
starting_state: The kept home after the setup walk, relaunched by the launcher with its network blocks on; no credential.
acts: views; clicks that open a disclosure; one press of Check account status, which asks the App's own Codex for the account state and changes nothing; nothing typed
never_clicked: any control that starts, resumes or forks a conversation
window_holds: full screen button Help: this button also has an action to zoom the window, Secondary Actions: zoom the window
